::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** May 27th [1870]  
**From:** Ottery  
**Manuscript:** MS  British Library Add MSS 54920: 239
:::

Dear [Mr Macmillan](people/person_939.qmd)
I agree with [Miss Sewell](people/person_1301.qmd)as to the alteration, otherwise it will do very nicely. I hope to be at home on the 1st or 2nd of June[^1]

Yours sincerely
C M Yonge

---

[^1]: Black-edged paper.
[^2]: The book in question must have been *European History* (1870).
